newsitem.title: UK: BA extends cutprice cargo promotion to March.
newsitem.headline: BA extends cutprice cargo promotion to March.

text.p: British Airways has again extended its special cutprice deals on air cargo rates whilst sticking to a separate plan to lift its global price tariff by up to 10 percent from Monday March 17, a BA Cargo spokesman said.

Under the latest extension BA's special promotion which started at the beginning of January will last until March 31 and again apply to pallets and bin rates. The special sale had been due to end March 16.
Next week BA's rates to South America and West Africa rise 10 percent whilst those to Canada, Europe, South Africa and Kenya stay unchanged.
The latest package cover covers 17 North Atlantic, 3 Latin American, 14 southern region covering the Middle East, east Africa and the Indian sub-continent, eight Pacific and 13 European routes.
As with the current "sale" the special low rates must be booked within 72 hours of departure and cannot replace existing or permanent bookings and are subject to availability, the spokesman added.
As a wholesaling carrier the special deals are aimed at freight forwarders and are for pallets and bins.
